SoylabComfyRouter.description: Run Comfy Router models with your personal API key. Inputs change with the selected model.

api_key.name: API key
api_key.tooltip: Leave blank to read API KEY.INI. A key entered here may be saved in the workflow.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Choose a model. The provider below is the Router execution route.

execution_provider.name: Provider
execution_provider.tooltip: Router serving route. Comfy is the default partner-model route; the model maker (for example, Runway) is separate. Only official alternate routes are listed.

model_execution_provider.name: Provider
model_execution_provider.tooltip: Router serving route. Comfy is the default partner-model route; the model maker (for example, Runway) is separate. Only official alternate routes are listed.

mode.name: Mode
mode.tooltip: Choose the operation or reference mode. Available options depend on the selected model.

model_mode.name: Mode
model_mode.tooltip: image, or auto with images only: image_1 is the first frame and image_2 is the last frame. reference: numbered images are references.

preset_voice.name: Preset voice
preset_voice.tooltip: Use this voice in preset_voice mode.

model_preset_voice.name: Preset voice
model_preset_voice.tooltip: Use this voice in preset_voice mode.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.tooltip: Resolution or size supported by this model and route.

model_resolution.name: Resolution
model_resolution.tooltip: Resolution or size supported by this model and route.

ratio.name: Aspect ratio
ratio.tooltip: Aspect ratio supported by the selected model.

model_ratio.name: Aspect ratio
model_ratio.tooltip: Aspect ratio supported by the selected model.

first_frame.name: First frame
first_frame.tooltip: Legacy socket. In image mode or image-only auto mode, image_1 can be used instead.

model_first_frame.name: First frame
model_first_frame.tooltip: Legacy socket. In image mode or image-only auto mode, image_1 can be used instead.

last_frame.name: Last frame
last_frame.tooltip: Legacy socket. In image mode or image-only auto mode, image_2 can be used instead.

model_last_frame.name: Last frame
model_last_frame.tooltip: Legacy socket. In image mode or image-only auto mode, image_2 can be used instead.

quality.name: Quality
quality.tooltip: Choose the quality supported by this model.

model_quality.name: Quality
model_quality.tooltip: Choose the quality supported by this model.

reference_images.name: Reference images
reference_images.tooltip: Connect up to the number of images supported by this model.

model_reference_images.name: Reference images
model_reference_images.tooltip: Connect up to the number of images supported by this model.

reference_videos.name: Reference videos
reference_videos.tooltip: Connect up to the number of videos supported by this model.

model_reference_videos.name: Reference videos
model_reference_videos.tooltip: Connect up to the number of videos supported by this model.

reference_audios.name: Reference audios
reference_audios.tooltip: Connect up to the number of audio clips supported by this model.

model_reference_audios.name: Reference audios
model_reference_audios.tooltip: Connect up to the number of audio clips supported by this model.

advanced_json.name: Advanced JSON
advanced_json.tooltip: Additional native JSON parameters for the selected model. The model is specified in the URL.

model_reference_images_image_1.name: Image 1
model_reference_images_image_1.tooltip: First frame in image or image-only auto mode; reference image 1 in reference mode.

model_reference_images_image_2.name: Image 2
model_reference_images_image_2.tooltip: Last frame in image or image-only auto mode; reference image 2 in reference mode.
